description: Fleet and P5 garage policy. Kept apart from detector settings so fleet/garage logic never depends on how a fault was detected. All values are team estimates; a scenario file may override garage.capacity.

garage.notes: HUNCH says P5 capacity is limited; 1 bay forces prioritisation. 15 min drive from any work site (no map at PDR).

work_order_triggers.notes: Create a work order when a prediction with confidence >= 0.6 arrives, or when a CRITICAL anomaly has persisted for 2 min with no prediction (fault_mode 'unknown'). A robot with an open work order gets its evidence appended instead of a second work order.

queue_priority.notes: CRITICAL before WARNING; within a severity, the robot predicted to fail soonest goes first; ties broken by age. Priority 1 = front of the queue.

swap_in_when.CRITICAL: immediately when the work order is created
swap_in_when.WARNING: when the failing robot is dispatched to P5

standby_selection.notes: Pick the eligible standby with the highest SOC; tie -> lowest robot_id. If none is eligible the mission is left uncovered and a STANDBY_UNAVAILABLE event is logged.

work_order_evidence.notes: Embed the last 60 min of the evidence channels at 1 point per minute (max 61 points per channel) so P5 can read the work order without access to our Parquet store.
